title: Delegations
intro: For each topic you may delegate your vote to one person you trust. Delegation is transitive — they may pass it onward — but a direct vote always overrides it, and you can revoke at any moment.
empty: You have no active delegations. Your vote is direct on every topic.
all_delegated: You have delegated on every available topic. Revoke one to redirect it.
delegate_hint: Search by name or email. The directory is restricted to verified citizens. Cycles are rejected at creation.
trust_body: Weight delegated to you flows through your direct votes on those topics — your delegates' choices follow yours.
trust_note: Vote thoughtfully on topics where others rely on you. Every delegation and every vote it carries is recorded in the audit log.
